Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the scope of collective bargaining for nontenured faculty at community and technical colleges.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to community and technical college collectivebargaining for nontenured faculty; and adding a new section to chapter28B.50 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.50 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature affirms that the constitutional requirement of dueprocess applies to nontenured faculty in community and technicalcolleges. Therefore, after an appropriate probationary period ofevaluation, nontenured faculty members whose contracts are not renewedshall be provided with the reasons for the nonrenewal and a process tochallenge the nonrenewal. The challenge process described in thissection does not apply when the nonrenewal of contract is based onenrollment, funding, or program changes. The details of the evaluation tools and processes, the length ofprobation, and the challenge process are subject to collectivebargaining. The evaluation of performance must include, but is not p. 1 SB 6746limited to, areas such as instructional skill, classroom management,professional preparation, and outcomes assessment.
